text:
priya (ml): quick flag 1: new model harmonia13b int4 onboarding showing intermittent alloc failures under long-session chat traffic.
omar (infra): any repro config? microbatch sizes? prefetch mode?
priya (ml): repro: ```model=harmonia13b
quant=int4
batch_size=5
max_new_tokens=1024
prefetch=aggressive
```
lucas (runtime): that pattern usually points to freelist fragmentation from KV prefetch pages + small allocations. int4 reduces size but increases churn.
jenny (prodex): can we run a short canary with conservative defaults before we change hosted defaults? want to measure quality impact.
omar (infra): plan: push canary to 2 GPU hosts with prefetch=lazy, batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=512, kv_eviction_threshold=0.72. add slot_compactor (qos=low). tag canary/harmonia13b/2026-04-05-a.
deploy-bot: rolling out canary -> hosts gpu-501, gpu-506 (tag: canary/harmonia13b/2026-04-05-a).
priya (ml): running long-context eval (150 sessions avg 9k history). baseline p95 ~440ms, rss_peak ~23.6GB, failure_rate ~1.1%.
lucas (runtime): on canary enable kv_prefetch_lazy=true, prefetch_skip_threshold=4000, reserve_ratio=0.05, and compactor.interval=60s. also collect freelist_fragmentation_pct.
omar (infra): flags applied. added freelist_fragmentation_pct to dashboard, set alert at 12% sustained.
priya (ml): 45m in: canary failure_rate dropped to 0.12%, p95 +30-40ms, rss -350MB. freelist_fragmentation_pct down from ~19%->6%.
jenny (prodex): what's the EM/QA delta int4-only vs int8-fallback? need numbers for release note.
priya (ml): quick A/B on QA subset: int4-only -0.7% EM. with int8-fallback for sessions >18k tokens EM gap reduces to -0.15%.
lucas (runtime): recommendation: for harmonia13b/int4 hosted defaults -> prefetch=lazy, batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=512, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, kv_prefetch_lazy=true, reserve_ratio=0.05, compactor.qos=low interval=60s, and auto-fallback to int8 at session_tokens>18k. add soft backoff: if eviction events >3 in 5m throttle prefetch for that session.
omar (infra): will gate change behind feature flag and run 24h canary. add kernel_colocation_score probe to telemetry (if >0.7 isolate heavy kernels).
jenny (prodex): I'll draft console message: "harmonia13b int4 defaults tuned for long-dialog stability; request Dedicated for >1k token jobs". include rollback triggers (EM delta >1%).
priya (ml): ML: will upload full eval CSV after 24h and run regression checks. revert plan ready.
deploy-bot: canary update: 0 OOMs in last 90m on canary hosts.
lucas (runtime): small follow-up: implement lightweight per-session compaction hint when predicted tail >6k tokens so compactor can prioritize those slots.
omar (infra): added compaction hint metric in canary.
priya (ml): action items captured: run full eval, keep canary 24h, propose default flip if EM regression <=1%, add routing to Dedicated for pinned high-token customers.
jenny (prodex): I'll update docs + release checklist.
priya (ml): TL;DR: root cause = aggressive prefetch + int4 + long KV chains. mitigations (lazy prefetch, lower max_new_tokens default, compactor, small reserve, int8-fallback) look effective in canary. will post final CSV tomorrow. :thumbsup:
